patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Amplemarket and Demandbase share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose Amplemarket only if your buying job matches “AI-powered multichannel outbound platform combining lead intelligence, sequences, delivera” rather than Demandbase's shape. Choose Demandbase only if your buying job matches “Enterprise ABM platform (Demandbase One) for account intelligence, intent, and go-to-marke” rather than Amplemarket's shape. Workflow advantage: Amplemarket leans sales-engagement, email-outreach; Demandbase leans data-enrichment, lead-management. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Amplemarket and Demandbase share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Amplemarket is AI-powered multichannel outbound platform combining lead intelligence, sequences, deliverability, and Duo AI assistants.; Demandbase is Enterprise ABM platform (Demandbase One) for account intelligence, intent, and go-to-market orchestration — custom-quote packaging..
- Workflow coverage skew: Amplemarket-leaning sales-engagement, email-outreach vs Demandbase-leaning data-enrichment, lead-management.
- Researched limits: Amplemarket — Not a full CRM pipeline system of record.; Demandbase — Demandbase One pricing is custom quote only — no published seat list prices.

Limitations — Amplemarket: Not a full CRM pipeline system of record.; Startup already $600/mo annual; Growth/Elite are custom-quoted.; Demandbase: Demandbase One pricing is custom quote only — no published seat list prices; Enterprise ABM scope means substantial implementation and change-management cost.

Poor-fit cases: Amplemarket is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Not a full CRM pipeline system of record. · Demandbase is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Demandbase One pricing is custom quote only — no published seat list prices · Avoid Amplemarket if you actually need Demandbase's motion (Enterprise ABM platform (Demandbase One) for account intelligence, intent, and g)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
